text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as the end of Bamboo Memory's
Junior Class year came into sightâ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer!
How was that just now?!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you so much!
To be honest, I felt pretty good about it myself~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo Memory has steadily improved her skills over this past year.
It's great to see that she can feel the results herself...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as her skills grew, another thing became
clear as well. That is, which races would bring out
her true potential the most.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the current data and race records,
that is most likely the stage where Bamboo Memory can shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, as her Trainer,
I shouldn't jump to conclusions just yet,
and should keep as open a mind as possible—"
choice_data_list: Let's go over our plan for the Classic year, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, got it!
The Junior class is wrapping up soon anyway!
choice_data_list: I plan to continue my training journey until next spring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"By doing that, I want to buy time to properly assess
Bamboo Memory's potential right up until the start
of the Classic GⅠ campaign...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! Just like a race!
Don't rush, build up power for when the moment comes!
And then unleash it all at once!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So that when I meet the ultimate rival, we can have the ultimate showdown...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Allllright! Power's overflowing!!
Trainer!
I'll be counting on you as always!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bamboo Memory and I reaffirmed our plan
to continue our warrior's pilgrimage together...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the next day,
while Bamboo Memory was doing her self-training—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
ââPhew!
Final set finished!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ……Hm?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Something feels off with my hoof? Better check it out just in case—)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah. Doesn't look like anything's cracked.
Though it feels a bit tight...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hrrrmmm.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (My training's been getting tougher and tougher lately, so maybe the usual aftercare just isn't cutting it anymore...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'll consult with Trainer about it later...
For today, I think I'll wrap things up and take care of my nails."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh, Ardan-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Mejiro Ardan-senpai. She was apparently born with a frail body, but she's an Umamusume of the Mejiro family who never lets that hold her back and works incredibly hard...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Ardan-senpai is in the same generation
as me, Yaeno, and Chiyono O in racing...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Bamboo-san.
...Are you feeling unwell?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I just came by to take care of my nails.
My nails are on the weaker side, you see,
so I gotta give 'em some TLC every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that was the case.
Taking good care of your own body is a truly wonderful mindset.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all! It's just what you
taught me, Trainer,
so it's really no big deal!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, Ardan-senpai... are you doing alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...During our earlier training,
I noticed a slight indisposition in myself,
so I took a short rest to get myself back in shape."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My pulse and breathing have returned
to normal, so I think I'll get back
to training in a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Are you really okay...? Maybe you shouldn't push yourself any harder today—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Thank you for your concern.
However, there's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I know my own body best.
I have no intention of overdoing it.
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Because right now, every single second counts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Because my body is frail, there's no telling when it might break down.
Naturally, the time I can devote to training is limited.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wish to face that precious opportunity with all my heart and soul.
By living every passing moment without regret,
I hope to fulfill the cherished wish held deep within my chest.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(...Every single word holds this mysterious weight, or rather, an overwhelming presence.
Is this... Ardan-senpai's resolve...?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...If it's okay, um...
could I ask what it is you're working so hard towards, Ardan-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—I have an older sister praised as the treasure of the Mejiro family,
who achieved the first Triple Tiara in history: Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Under the overwhelming shadow of my sister, in the "present," I am forever seen as merely "Mejiro Ramonu's little sister," my own name erased from the world—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I want to break free from this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Through racing, I want to leave a single trail of light in "this" world—a testament that I lived.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Not as 'Mejiro Ramonu's little sister,' but as an individual—as 'Mejiro Ardan'—I want to carve my mark upon this world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That is my dearest wish... or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's my "dream."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...That really struck a chord in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ardan-senpai's "dream," and the resolve... the passion she has for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san...—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To Ardan-senpai...
her older sister is a goal to surpass, and a rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
They are someone that I will inevitably have to face eventually.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's crazy hype...!
I think that's insanely passionate, for real...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Following Ardan-senpai's example, I want to do my best every day
so that I can put my all into every single moment, sir...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So――
Thank you very much for talking to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all...
If anything, I'm the one who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how passionately you strive and push yourself
every single day, Bamboo-san...
gives me courage as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Was that really the case!?
I-I didn't notice at all...
I was always so full of my own problems...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
That's so like Bamboo-san as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us take care of our bodies
and strive toward our future paths together."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it's already sunset.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...I've gotta work way harder too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Through racing, I want to leave a single trail of light in "this" world—a testament that I lived.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Not as 'Mejiro Ramonu's little sister,' but as an individual—as 'Mejiro Ardan'—I want to carve my mark upon this world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That is my dearest wish... or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's my "dream."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, without fail, I want to catch up to her...
I want to run alongside her...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That is my "dream"!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To hone my mind and body through battles against the "strong", and repay the great debt I owe to my grandparents...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "That is what I desire at the end of this battle. To borrow Bamboo-san's words—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is my "dream."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has a burning "dream"...!
And to make that "dream" come true,
they sweat, strive, and put their lives on the line...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let myself lose to anyone! I'll become a rival worthy of you all!
I'm gonna set my soul ablaze even more!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Blaze on!!
Bamboo! Memory!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "I'm continuing my warrior training in the Classic Year too! Time to get fired uuuup!!"
